question: The reciprocal of the sum of the reciprocals of (5)/(7) and (9)/(5) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The reciprocal of the sum of the reciprocals of (5/7) and (9/5).

**Formula used:**

Reciprocal of the sum of reciprocals = 1 / (1/a + 1/b)

**Calculation:**

Reciprocal of (5/7) = 7/5

Reciprocal of (9/5) = 5/9

⇒ Sum of the reciprocals = 7/5 + 5/9

⇒ Sum of the reciprocals = (63 + 25)/45 = 88/45

⇒ Reciprocal of the sum = 1 / (88/45)

⇒ Reciprocal = 45/88

**∴ The answer is 45/88.**
